# The Statistics window's win percentage is computed in x87 Extended:
# Int(Wins / (Wins + Losses) × 10000) / 100. With 39 wins and 11 losses the
# division rounds just below 0.78, and the window should show 77.99, not 78
# (float64 gives 78). Then 1 win and 2 losses: 33.33.
Wins 39
Losses 11
party 25 5
> start
> set Wins 1
> set Losses 2
> quit
exit 0
save line 10: "39" -> "1"
save line 11: "11" -> "2"
